decisions.reason: It builds on the core offer and already shows a strong customer value signal, so for a growing firm the option value of keeping it clearly exceeds the likely carrying cost.
As a close extension of the established machinery range, it is still early and uncertain enough that management would usually keep it on the market unless clear commercial weakness appears.
Because it is a flagship multi-model line aligned with the firm's stated strategic direction, management is very unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch.
Although the evidence is weaker than for the other launches, it is close to the firm's existing business and the firm has the resources and incentive to preserve this option for another year.
